description: Musical artists linked to southwest London, from Barnes to Wimbledon.

places.name: Barnes
places.note: Barnes in the London Borough of Richmond upon Thames, not other towns named Barnes.

places.name: Putney
places.note: District in the London Borough of Wandsworth.

places.name: Roehampton
places.note: SW15. MusicBrainz has no Roehampton area, so only Wikidata can place someone here.

places.name: Richmond
places.note: Richmond district in London. Richmond in Virginia, Yorkshire, and elsewhere are rejected by area id.

places.name: Kew
places.note: Kew in Richmond. The MusicBrainz city named Kew is in Johannesburg, so that MBID is not used.

places.name: Ham
places.note: Ham in Richmond upon Thames. A name-only MusicBrainz search also hits Ham in Belgium and East Ham.

places.name: Petersham
places.note: Petersham in Richmond upon Thames. The only MusicBrainz area named Petersham is in Massachusetts.

places.name: Kingston upon Thames
places.note: The town district, which is the part of Kingston that lines up with KT1 and KT2.

places.name: Norbiton
places.note: Norbiton is in KT2. MusicBrainz has no Norbiton area.

places.name: Wimbledon
places.note: Wimbledon district in Merton. A US city named Wimbledon is a different MusicBrainz area and is ignored.

places.name: Mortlake
places.note: Mortlake district in Richmond upon Thames. A city named Mortlake in Victoria, Australia is ignored.

places.name: East Sheen
places.note: East Sheen shares SW14 with Mortlake. MusicBrainz has no East Sheen area.

places.name: Fulham
places.note: Fulham district. The wider borough of Hammersmith and Fulham is not treated as SW6.

places.name: Southfields
places.note: Southfields sits in SW18, inside the borough of Wandsworth.

places.name: Wandsworth (borough)
places.note: London Borough of Wandsworth. Editors often stop at the borough, which also covers Putney, Battersea, Balham and Tooting, so this is wider than SW18.

places.name: Kingston upon Thames (borough)
places.note: Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames, including Surbiton and New Malden. Wider than KT1 and KT2.

places.name: Richmond upon Thames (borough)
places.note: London Borough of Richmond upon Thames, including Twickenham, Teddington and Hampton. Wider than TW9 and TW10.
